gre_general.value: General GRE is optional; leaving it out does not hurt the application.
gre_general.quote: General and Subject Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are optional.

gre_subject.value: Subject GRE is optional; leaving it out does not hurt the application.
gre_subject.quote: General and Subject Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are optional.

supervisor.value: Applicants need not name a faculty member, though it helps.
supervisor.quote: Do I need to identify a faculty member that I am interested in working with?

funding.value: PhD students in good standing are guaranteed 5 years of support through teaching, research assistantships and similar.
funding.quote: students, maintaining satisfactoral progress, in the Ph.D. program are guaranteed 5 years of support through teaching assistantship, research, etc.

entry_route.value: Apply from a U.S.-equivalent bachelor's degree. An Indian 3-year bachelor's alone is not enough; it must be followed by a 2-year master's.
entry_route.quote: You would need a 3-year Bachelor’s Degree and a 2-year Master’s Degree for the equivalent of a U.S. Bachelor’s. A 3-year Bachelor’s degree alone would not meet our requirements for admission.

notes: New Astrophysics PhD (core courses oriented to astrophysics) run by the same department as the Physics PhD, with a separate personal statement.
